title: California overlay
description: Applies California Building Code Chapter 11B requirements that are stricter than or additional to the 2010 ADA Standards: wider and longer parking spaces, access-aisle markings, tow-away and fine signage, detectable warnings at curb ramps, and a lower maximum for door hardware.

sources.title: California Building Code, Title 24, Part 2, Chapter 11B — Accessibility to public buildings
Polling Place Accessibility Guidelines and Survey Checklist

kit.name: Surface-applied detectable warning mat
kit.description: Temporary truncated-dome mat across the full width of a curb ramp at the street edge.

kit.name: Portable tow-away notice for accessible spaces

parking.space-width.help: California requires accessible car spaces at least 108 inches (9 feet) wide. Measure from the center of one line to the center of the other.

parking.van-combined-width.help: California allows a 144-inch van space with a 60-inch aisle, or a 108-inch space with a 96-inch aisle. Both add up to 204 inches.

parking.sign-height.help: Measure from the ground to the bottom of the sign: at least 60 inches, or 80 inches where the sign is in a walkway.

entrance.hardware-height.help: California limits door hardware to 34–44 inches above the floor. Measure to the center of the handle or button.

entrance.opening-force.help: California limits exterior and interior hinged doors to 5 lbf. Hook the gauge at the latch side and pull slowly at a right angle.

item.prompt: How long is the accessible parking space?
item.help: California requires accessible spaces at least 216 inches (18 feet) long.

fix.summary: Mark a full-length temporary space with cones and tape.

item.prompt: Is each access aisle outlined in blue, hatched, and marked “NO PARKING” in white letters at least 12 inches high?

fix.summary: Cone off the aisle and post a “No parking — access aisle” sign for election day; report the missing markings to the facility.

item.prompt: Does each accessible-space sign show the minimum fine (“Minimum Fine $250”)?

fix.summary: Report the missing fine plate to the facility; it is a permanent sign requirement.

item.prompt: Is a tow-away sign posted at each lot entrance or next to the accessible spaces?

fix.summary: Post a portable tow-away notice next to the accessible spaces and report the missing sign to the facility.

item.prompt: Does the curb ramp have a detectable warning surface (truncated domes) across its full width at the street edge?

fix.summary: Tape a surface-applied detectable warning mat across the bottom of the curb ramp.
